error.text:
OOMKilled (oom_kill) on payments/api-7d8c: Container worker exceeded memory limit

Possible causes (most → least likely):
  1. Working set legitimately exceeds the memory limit — raise the limit/request to match real usage.
  2. Usage grows unbounded over time (heap or cache leak) until it hits the limit.
  3. A transient burst (large request, batch job, fan-in) briefly exceeded the limit.
  4. Another container in the same pod consumed the shared memory budget.

This is a symptom signal — confirming the cause requires correlation (workload spec, recent config/RBAC changes, node conditions, dependency health). Raw event: Container worker exceeded memory limit
